observations: A solid black figure balances on one leg at center, one arm raised and one extended outward, against a flat orange field above a black ground strip.
Radiating from the figure's round head are two kinds of lines: tight zigzag bursts near the top and looser horizontal waves spreading outward at mid-height, all drawn in black on orange.
The head carries two small orange X marks for eyes; an orange artist signature sits in the lower-left corner of the black ground strip.
reading: The figure holds a one-legged stance that reads as either mid-fall or mid-leap—the body's balance is unresolved. Radiating lines fan outward in two distinct rhythms: sharp zigzags above, slower waves below, giving the surrounding space a different quality from the stillness of the silhouette. The X-marked eyes, a recurring mark in this owned subset, keep the figure unreadable rather than expressive.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, immediate neighbor nnxyz nnotb #91 shares the same radiating-line pattern and X-marked face on a warm ground, but that figure is seated and still, its lines are yellow on red, making posture and color contrast visible between the two works.

connections.reason: Both works place a black X-eyed figure against a warm solid ground with the same two-rhythm radiating lines, but #91's figure is seated and its lines are yellow on red, making the contrast in posture and color directly visible.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the figure's weight appear to rest, and how do the two different line rhythms—tight zigzags above versus slower waves at mid-height—relate to that point of balance?
ambiguities: The stance could read as a frozen fall, a dance move, or a kick; the image alone does not resolve which.
nnxyz nifty faces #54 and nnxyz nnotb #93 share no strong formal connection to this work beyond the artist's mark, so neither is included as a connection.
